text: Maya Okafor is a freelance illustrator who has spent the last eight years bringing picture books to life, with a particular love for stories about grandparents, garden animals and small acts of courage. Working mostly in gouache and hand-cut paper, she builds each page around soft, textured light, and she's happiest when a child spots a tiny detail she tucked into the corner of a spread. Based in Bristol, she shares her studio with two rescue greyhounds and a shelf of well-loved picture books that inspire her every day.
